subject: Pilot fuel request and allocation for Cloud Bazaar Accelerator cohort
messages:
From: Maya Turner <maya@cloudbazaar.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accelerator@cloudbazaar.co
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promo credits + trial extension for Cloud Bazaar Spring cohort

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Hope you're both well. We're kicking off the Spring 2028 Cloud Bazaar Accelerator (cohort starts 2028-05-02) and would like to request partner-sponsored trial fuel from Redwood to support 10 early-stage startups. High level ask: 10 accounts, 90-day trial, $1,500 in credits per account (total $15,000).

Use case: light LLM-powered prototypes (chat + embeddings) with bursty traffic during demo week. We expect most usage to stay under 100k tokens/month per team but there will be short spikes.

Attached: CB_Accelerator_SOW.pdf (draft), cloud-bazaar-proposed-credits.xlsx (allocation).

Could you confirm what approvals you need on your side (SOW, PO, signed terms), and an expected lead time to issue the credits once paperwork is in? We're on a tight timeline to onboard the cohort.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

—
Maya Turner
Head of Programs, Cloud Bazaar Accelerator
maya@cloudbazaar.co

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Turner <maya@cloudbazaar.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo credits + trial extension for Cloud Bazaar Spring cohort

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the attachments.

Quick confirmation: we can support partner-sourced credits for accelerators but need a signed SOW and a PO before issuance. Operationally we also require a brief usage profile per cohort (expected peak tokens, any restricted data requirements) so our gating and quota policies can be configured.

Cc'ing Soojin (partner ops) to start the activation checklist. Ben — can you flag whether this fits our current accelerator playbook?

I'll aim to get internal approvals once we have the signed SOW + PO. Lead time is typically 3 business days after paperwork is finalized.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo credits + trial extension for Cloud Bazaar Spring cohort

Vanessa / Soojin — reviewed the attachments. The ask aligns with our standard accelerator bundle (10x $1.5k). I recommend we approve conditionally:

- Approve $15k total in account-level credits, 90-day duration.
- Credits to be issued only after signed SOW + PO + acceptance of Redwood cohort terms (attached redwood-cohort-terms-draft.docx).
- Apply per-account quotas with a 200k token/month soft cap and alerting for spikes >300k to avoid runaway bill.

I've added a couple of comments to the spreadsheet (allocation sheet) around start dates and ideal activation windows.

If Finance needs a justification, I can route internally to tie to partner motion budget.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Turner <maya@cloudbazaar.co>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo credits + trial extension for Cloud Bazaar Spring cohort

Hi Maya — thanks for the docs. Operational checklist and next steps below: 

1) Please countersign the attached SOW (CB_Accelerator_SOW.pdf) and share a PO referencing DBL-4582.
2) Confirm the list of participant account emails (or a CSV) by 2028-04-20 so we can pre-provision accounts.
3) Confirm whether any cohorts require private VPC deployment or if hosted API is sufficient (default).

Attachments: redwood-cohort-terms-draft.docx (terms), sample-activation-playbook.pdf (ops).

Once we have signed SOW + PO we'll queue the credit issuance; typical ops lead time 2–3 business days. I'll follow up with an activation window proposal.

On the note about quota enforcement: we will auto-enforce the soft cap Ben suggested and send escalation to partner owner if thresholds are crossed.

Thanks — Soojin
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: Cloud Bazaar accelerator — brief technical check

Heads up — quick technical note for the activation plan: if any startup requests embeddings-heavy workloads with vector indexes >4M vectors we should route those to a dedicated instance (or a quantized variant) to avoid noisy neighbors on hosted pools.

Can we add a checkbox in the intake CSV where Cloud Bazaar indicates expected index sizes? That will save a last-minute rework on the provisioning side.

I'll sync with infra to ensure any batch-quant options are pre-approved for this cohort.

—Karthik

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Turner <maya@cloudbazaar.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Apr 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo credits + trial extension for Cloud Bazaar Spring cohort

Maya — quick update and confirmation: happy to move forward.

Summary of what Redwood will provide:
- $15,000 in partner-funded credits, applied as 10x $1,500 account coupons, valid for 90 days from each account activation.
- Activation once SOW signed and PO received (referencing DBL-4582).
- Soft caps and alerting: 200k token/month soft cap per account; automated alerts and manual review for spikes >300k.
- Operational onboarding playbook and intake template (will send with activation email).

Next steps for Cloud Bazaar: countersign SOW, send PO, and provide participant CSV with an extra column for "expected vector index size" (per Karthik's request).

I'll send the DocuSign link for the SOW in a follow-up. Once executed, ops will queue issuance and confirm the activation window (2–3 business days).

Thanks — looking forward to supporting the cohort.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
